candidates.name: Toxoplasmosis
support_spans: MRI of the brain demonstrated a 2.7-cm ring-enhancing lesion in the right temporal lobe with mass effect
Serum toxoplasma IgG was elevated
CSF studies showed 48 cells/µL (97% lymphocytes) with positive toxoplasma IgG and DNA-PCR for Toxoplasma gondii (286 copies/mL)
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and test results are consistent with toxoplasmosis, particularly the ring-enhancing lesion and positive toxoplasma IgG and DNA-PCR.

candidates.name: Pneumocystis pneumonia
support_spans: Chest radiograph showed a new left upper lobe opacification with diffuse reticulonodular interstitial prominence
CT scan of the chest confirmed extensive reticulonodular interstitial infiltrates with focal consolidation in the left upper lobe
candidates.why: The patient's respiratory symptoms and test results are consistent with pneumocystis pneumonia, particularly the reticulonodular interstitial infiltrates.

candidates.name: Toxoplasmosis
support_spans: He was found to have HIV infection with a CD4 count <20 cells/µL and an HIV viral load of 191 000 copies/mL
Histopathologic examination of the brain tissue revealed bradyzoites and tachyzoites
candidates.why: The patient's immunocompromised state due to HIV infection increases the risk of toxoplasmosis.
